description: The tyrants who led Iran made the world more dangerous and more cruel. I am glad they are gone. I also believe we are not safer today to have a president who starts wars without approval of the U.S. Congress. Trump’s outlandish decisions are no longer a mystery–it was never chaos; it was beta test
